title: Alchemy of Souls
hook: How does Alchemy of Souls Part 2 end? Naksu inside Bu-yeon, the firebird killed, and the marriage that closes the saga, explained.

sections.heading: Three years later, a hardened Jang Uk
sections.body: Part 2 opens three years after the tragedy engineered by Jin Mu. Jang Uk returns from apparent death, kept alive by the Ice Stone lodged in his body, and has become a cold, relentless hunter of soul shifters, isolated by his grief over losing Mu-deok. He then crosses paths with Jin Bu-yeon, the enigmatic Jinyowon heiress whose words and instincts keep echoing those of Naksu. The season's central mystery becomes the question of whose soul truly inhabits Bu-yeon's body, and whether the woman Jang Uk loved has somehow survived inside this new identity standing before him.

sections.heading: Killing the firebird
sections.body: The climactic threat is a firebird unleashed in the conflict surrounding Jin Mu's schemes. In the decisive confrontation, Jang Uk freezes the firebird in place and draws a bow forged from his own energy, taking aim at the creature. Jin Bu-yeon channels the power of the seven stars, transferring that energy into his arrow to amplify the shot. The combined strike brings the firebird down, ending the supernatural catastrophe that has been building across the season. It is a partnered victory, the two leads pooling their abilities to destroy the threat that the soul-shifting chaos had set loose upon the world.

sections.heading: Whose soul lives in Bu-yeon's body
sections.body: The emotional core resolves the identity puzzle. Naksu, whose soul has been residing in Jin Bu-yeon's body, chooses to vanish without telling Jang Uk, entering a powerful magical prison to spare him further pain. She returns unharmed, and Jang Uk, who has worked out the truth, resolves to stay beside her. The original consciousness, Jin Bu-yeon, ultimately decides her own mission is complete and relinquishes the body, leaving it to Naksu. The arrangement lets the woman Jang Uk loves remain with him rather than dissipating, untangling the soul-shifter premise that had separated them.

sections.heading: Married and hunting relics
sections.body: The finale jumps ahead to find Jang Uk and Naksu married and content. The closing scene places the couple together at Danhyanggok, atop a great tree, now on a shared quest to recapture evil souls and relics that have escaped from the Jin family's relic cave. Jang Uk tells her to stay right by his side, sealing the partnership as both romantic and adventuring. After the heartbreak, fake deaths and body-swapping that defined the saga, the series lands on a warm, settled note: the leads reunited, the firebird destroyed, and the two riding off into an open-ended life of monster-hunting together.

final_image: Atop a towering tree at Danhyanggok, the married Jang Uk and Naksu set off together to chase down the escaped relics and souls, his words asking her to stay right by his side.

lingering_questions.q: Does Naksu survive, and whose body is she in?
lingering_questions.a: Yes. Naksu's soul lives on inside Jin Bu-yeon's body. After Naksu briefly enters a magical prison and returns, the original Bu-yeon consciousness chooses to leave, deciding her mission is done and giving the body to Naksu so she can stay with Jang Uk.

Jang Uk freezes the firebird and fires an arrow made from his own energy, while Jin Bu-yeon transfers the power of the seven stars into the shot to strengthen it. Their combined strike kills the creature and ends the season's supernatural threat.
